summary.note: Static analysis and quick inspection produced a ranked top-10 list of likely problems affecting determinism, type-safety, error-handling, and rendering patches. See each entry for evidence and remediation notes.

issue.title: Determinism leakage: use of Math.random in simulation/renderer code
issue.impact: Breaks reproducibility of seeded deterministic simulations and tests.
issue.remediation: Replace Math.random with injected RNG (GameState.rng.next()). Add lint rule to forbid Math.random in sim-critical code and add reproducibility tests.

issue.title: Widespread use of `any` and silent error swallowing
issue.impact: Runtime errors hidden, weak type guarantees, harder debugging and brittle behavior across environments.
issue.remediation: Tighten types, introduce small adapter interfaces, and replace broad try/catch silence with logger.error and targeted fallbacks.

issue.title: Logger methods emit to console unconditionally
issue.impact: Verbose or leaking logs in production and noisy CI output; harder to mock in tests.
issue.remediation: Add configurable log level and allow test harness to substitute a logger. Keep debug gating but make info/warn/error respect configuration.

issue.title: RNG int() and pick() boundaries require unit tests
issue.impact: Potential off-by-one or bias in callers expecting different inclusive/exclusive semantics.
issue.remediation: Add unit tests verifying inclusive bounds for int() and behavior of pick() on edge cases; document API semantics in README/docs.

issue.title: LRUAssetPool disposal swallows disposal errors silently
issue.impact: Resource disposal failures hidden; potential leaks or unexpected memory usage.
issue.remediation: Log disposal errors via logger.error and consider failing fast in CI/test mode. Add unit tests for eviction and dispose callback invocation.

issue.title: Excessive prototype patching/global side-effects in renderer effects
issue.impact: Fragile across three.js versions, brittle tests, unexpected interactions with other code.
issue.remediation: Isolate patches behind an explicit opt-in function, document patch surface, and feature-detect carefully. Add fallbacks and log failures.

issue.title: TODOs and incomplete AI/formation logic
issue.impact: Unfinished features can produce incorrect AI behavior in some scenarios.
issue.remediation: Convert TODOs into tracked tasks with tests; add minimal safe default behavior and tests for formation behavior.

issue.title: Environment-dependent globals and branching (window/process)
issue.impact: Different behavior between Node test runner and browser; possible flakiness in CI.
issue.remediation: Create a single environment abstraction/config and set env flags explicitly in tests and CI.

issue.title: Loose GameState types and optional unknowns
issue.impact: Hidden contract mismatches, possible runtime undefined errors.
issue.remediation: Tighten the GameState shapes with smaller interfaces and add a bootstrap-time validator that asserts required fields are present in CI/test mode.

issue.title: Silent fallbacks for missing assets/configs
issue.impact: Misconfiguration may go unnoticed; visuals or behavior may silently degrade.
issue.remediation: Log warnings when defaults are used and add a strict mode to fail on missing config/assets in CI.

notes.recommendation: Prioritize removing Math.random from simulation and adding RNG unit tests. Next priority: stop silencing errors and add logging for disposal and patching failures.

quickWins.item: Add RNG unit tests for deterministic sequences.
Add a lint rule banning Math.random in `src/core`.
Change dispose error swallowing to logger.error in `src/core/assetPool.ts`.
